# Howard Hinnant date

Unmodified `include/date/date.h` from upstream tag **v3.0.5**:
https://github.com/HowardHinnant/date/blob/v3.0.5/include/date/date.h

SHA-256: `8c295bc53964ec02fa99ef10816c190a4c34fdcbf1ce2dcc8e451a29932f9d2c`.

The MIT license and copyright notices are retained at the top of the header.
Vendoring the header makes native calendar operations buildable offline; timezone
database support is a separate capability.
